ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) comprising approximately 90% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are primarily localized in water spray and minor mottling on the distal leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is localized on the leading edge of the left lobe; extensive high-intensity pixel noise (water droplets) is overlaid across the central and right lobe surfaces, obscuring underlying pigmentation patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees; the notch apex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along both trailing edges; significant macro-indentation (notch) present at the mid-point of the right lobe's trailing edge; distal tips exhibit high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity (S-curve) at the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with terminal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical mid-intensity linear marks visible on the left lobe, partially obscured by low resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped indentation/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the ventral surface by high-velocity water spray/droplets, particularly concentrated on the right lobe and central region.
